title: Carolina Bauernhaus Greenville
venue_description:
Overview

Carolina Bauernhaus Greenville is a craft brewery and community gathering space located in the West Greenville Village area. The brewery has become known for its welcoming atmosphere and commitment to supporting local artists and musicians.

Music and Events

Carolina Bauernhaus hosts weekly open mic nights every Wednesday from 6-9 PM featuring musicians comedians poets and storytellers. All genres and performance styles are welcome in this inclusive creative environment. The venue also partners with the Greenville Chapter of NSAI (Nashville Songwriters Association International) to host songwriter showcases on the fourth Sunday of each month starting at 4 PM. The brewery regularly features special music events and has established itself as a cultural hub in West Greenville.

Brewery Experience

As a full-service brewery Carolina Bauernhaus offers a selection of craft beers brewed on-site. The space combines quality beer with community programming creating a laid-back environment where both performers and audience members feel welcome. The brewery emphasizes local community connections and has built a reputation for fostering creativity and artistic expression.

Atmosphere and Community

The venue maintains a casual welcoming vibe that appeals to both regulars and newcomers. With its West Greenville location the brewery serves as a neighborhood gathering spot where people can enjoy craft beer live music and creative performances. The staff is known for being friendly and supportive of the arts making it an ideal venue for both established and emerging performers.

title: Coffee Underground
venue_description:
Historic Venue Overview

Coffee Underground is a beloved Greenville institution that has been serving the community since 1995. Located just 14 steps down from Main Street at the corner of Coffee and Main this underground cafe has become a cultural landmark in downtown Greenville. The venue combines the ambiance of a cozy coffee house with a thriving performance space.

Poetry and Performance Programming

Coffee Underground is home to Wits End Poetry the longest-running poetry open mic in the Upstate and throughout South Carolina celebrating over 20 years of poetry programming. Say What Open Mic takes place every Sunday at 7:30 PM (doors at 7 PM) featuring a full night of open mic slots for local poets on a first-come first-serve basis. The venue has become nationally recognized with the Greenville Slam Team ranked 8th in the nation. Beyond poetry the theater room hosts weekly stand-up comedy improv sketch performances and features from local songwriters. The venue also presents TedX Salons independent film screenings and touring comics from around the world.

Cafe Experience

Specializing in homemade desserts and delicious coffees using beans roasted on premises Coffee Underground serves an all-day breakfast and lunch menu. The cafe offers specialty coffee drinks frozen espresso drinks teas and a full menu of breakfast items sandwiches salads and decadent desserts. Sunday brunch is a popular tradition. The cafe also serves beer wine and cocktails creating a complete dining and entertainment experience.

Atmosphere and Culture

The underground location creates an intimate bohemian atmosphere with eclectic seating including cozy couches tables and chairs. The venue attracts a diverse crowd from laptop users and book readers to families and performers. Local art adorns the walls and the space has a unique character that sets it apart from typical coffee shops. Coffee Underground has established itself as a true cultural hotspot where creativity community and quality refreshments come together.

title: Chicora Alley
venue_description:
Restaurant and Music Venue

Chicora Alley Downtown is a unique Caribbean-fusion restaurant and bar that has been a Falls Park sensation for nearly two decades. Located on the second floor at the corner of Main and Boggs Streets (historical Chicora Street) the venue sits in the heart of downtown Greenville near the beautiful Reedy River area.

Live Music Programming

Chicora Alley features live jazz blues and reggae music almost every night of the week. The venue hosts open blues jams on the first second and third Wednesdays of each month starting at 8 PM where musicians are invited to bring their instruments and amplifiers with drums and bass provided. Wednesday nights are reserved for jazz programming with jazz jams on select weeks and big band performances. The venue regularly features the Greenville Jazz Collective and other talented local musicians. The intimate setting with its cozy atmosphere makes it an ideal venue for both performers and music enthusiasts.

Food and Drink

The restaurant specializes in flavorful Southern-Caribbean fusion cuisine offering both vegan and meat options. Popular menu items include the famous Mile High Nachos vegan burritos mushroom burgers black bean burgers beef brisket and shrimp dishes. The venue serves craft beer wine and cocktails alongside its diverse food menu. Chicora Alley prides itself on bold flavors and hearty spices that reflect its island-inspired cuisine.

History and Atmosphere

The name Chicora comes from the Native American word meaning Land of the Healing Breeze. The building sits on land that was once part of the Chicora College campus. After walking the beautiful Reedy River area tourists and local regulars alike come to enjoy the laid-back island vibe. The venue offers a full-service bar and restaurant experience with a welcoming atmosphere perfect for relaxing after exploring Falls Park. Sports are also shown on TV making it a versatile entertainment destination.
location: 608 S Main St Unit B Greenville SC 29601

title: Fireforge Crafted Beer
venue_description:
Award-Winning Brewery Overview

Fireforge Crafted Beer is a locally-owned award-winning small-batch craft brewery taproom kitchen and biergarden located in downtown Greenville. Situated just a 10-minute walk from Bon Secours Wellness Arena at 311 E Washington Street the brewery has become a cornerstone of Greenville's craft beer and live music scene.

Music and Entertainment

Fireforge is home to the long-running Greenville Jazz Collective Sunday Jazz Jam which takes place most Sundays from 4-7 PM. This open jam welcomes musicians of all ages and skill levels to improvise jazz with a house band of local jazz professionals. The venue also hosts weekly bluegrass jams and features live music throughout the week. Fireforge presents their annual ForgeFest Music Festival a multi-day celebration featuring local and regional bands across multiple stages. The brewery regularly hosts special music events including bluegrass sessions and performances by touring acts.

Brewery and Culinary Experience

With 20+ in-house brewed beers on draft Fireforge offers an impressive selection alongside wine cider and non-alcoholic beverages. The brewery has won numerous awards including Greenville News Community Choice Awards for Best Brewpub/Brewery (2024 & 2025) Best Chef-Alex Morgan (2025) Best Event Venue (2024) and Post & Courier Greenville's BEST Awards for Local Brewery (2023 2024 & 2025). The kitchen serves a locally-inspired menu of shareable snacks sandwiches and sides allowing guests to explore culinary flavors through beer and food pairings.

Venue and Events

The brewery features both an indoor taproom and an outdoor biergarden providing diverse seating options. Annual festivals include Gasparilla Pirate Day Oktoberfest Polish Fest and ForgeFest Music Festival. In addition to music programming Fireforge hosts weekly bingo and trivia nights. The venue has established itself as a community gathering space where quality craft beer creative food and live entertainment come together in a welcoming atmosphere.

title: 3 Friends Bar & Grill
venue_description:
Restaurant and Live Music Venue

3 Friends Bar & Grill opened in 2017 in Taylors South Carolina bringing fresh American fare and live music to the Piedmont area near Greenville. Founded by Jim Rybak after 40 years in the restaurant industry the venue has quickly earned a reputation for quality food friendly service and a fun atmosphere.

Live Music Programming

3 Friends hosts open mic jam sessions every Monday night at 7 PM until close. The weekly event features house band members Mark Curtis and Ronnie Ellis providing backing support for musicians of all skill levels. Performers are welcome to bring their instruments and jam in a relaxed supportive environment. The venue also features live band performances on weekends and regular karaoke nights making it a popular local entertainment destination. The commitment to supporting local musicians has become a defining characteristic of the venue.

Food and Dining Experience

The restaurant specializes in fresh American cuisine with a diverse menu including burgers pasta steak and seafood. Everything is made fresh with no frozen ingredients. Popular menu items include garlic parmesan wings shrimp and grits prime rib and chicken tenders. The full bar offers a selection of wine beer and cocktails to complement the food menu. The venue emphasizes quality preparation and fresh ingredients in all dishes.

Venue Features

3 Friends Bar & Grill features both indoor and outdoor seating creating a casual welcoming atmosphere suitable for families and groups. The venue includes a private banquet room perfect for hosting parties and special events. The combination of quality food live entertainment and friendly service has made 3 Friends a go-to spot in the Taylors community for both dining and nightlife.

title: Golden Grove Farm & Brew
venue_description:
Farm Brewery and Event Space

Golden Grove Farm & Brew is a unique farm brewery located in Piedmont South Carolina just outside Greenville. The venue combines craft beer production with outdoor recreation and live music creating a distinctive destination that appeals to beer enthusiasts musicians and outdoor lovers alike.

Music Events and Jams

Golden Grove hosts weekly open mic jam sessions every Monday evening starting at 7 PM welcoming musicians of all skill levels to participate. The venue features Funky Dunky performances on the 2nd and 4th Thursday of each month with guest artists backed by Dave Cannon on bass and Jason Phillips on drums and percussion. Musicians are encouraged to bring their instruments and sit in during the second set. The laid-back farm setting provides an ideal atmosphere for jam sessions and live performances. Basic backline equipment is available for performers.

Brewery and Facilities

The farm brewery offers award-winning craft beers brewed on-site in a relaxed outdoor setting. Golden Grove features both indoor taproom space and extensive outdoor seating areas allowing guests to enjoy beverages in a natural farm environment. The venue is family-friendly and welcomes all ages. In addition to the brewery Golden Grove includes an 18-hole disc golf course providing outdoor recreation opportunities for visitors.

Event Programming

Beyond regular music programming Golden Grove hosts special events throughout the year including artisan markets festivals and community gatherings. The Peace Love & Pints event showcases local vendors food trucks live music and games in a family-friendly atmosphere. The venue has established itself as a community gathering space where craft beer outdoor activities and live music create a unique experience in the Greenville area.

title: Blues Boulevard Jazz
venue_description:
Premier Jazz and Blues Venue

Blues Boulevard Jazz is a premier jazz and blues venue located in downtown Greenville along the scenic River Walk at 300 River Street Suite 203. The venue features a contemporary intimate setting designed to recreate the nostalgic atmosphere of an old underground jazz parlor with cozy seating soft lighting and exceptional acoustics.

Live Music Programming

Blues Boulevard showcases live jazz and blues acts Wednesday through Saturday from 6 PM to midnight. The venue hosts Shane Pruitt Blues Jam on the first Tuesday of each month where the Shane Pruitt Band leads an open blues jam session welcoming musicians and vocalists of the genre. Open jazz jam sessions are also scheduled periodically featuring house musicians Matt Dingledine on guitar Tim Blackwell on drums and Shannon Hoover on bass who perform a first set then invite other musicians to join on stage for the second set. The venue regularly features talented performers including Jorge Garcia Steve Galloway Dee Lucas and the house band Jazzsmith. Blues Boulevard attracts both local musicians and touring acts creating an authentic jazz club experience.

Dining Experience

The venue offers a diverse menu featuring signature tapas and delectable entrees. Popular dishes include salmon with orange-brown sugar Cajun glaze corn nuggets mac and cheese bites and chicken quesadillas. The bar serves homemade cocktails craft beers and a selection of wines. Food and drinks are reasonably priced and the staff is known for friendly attentive service. A music cover charge applies for entertainment.

Atmosphere and Location

Blues Boulevard creates an intimate sophisticated atmosphere with its underground jazz parlor aesthetic. The venue is beautifully located near the water along Greenville's River Walk making it an ideal spot for date nights and special evenings out. The close quarters add to the charm and authenticity of the jazz club experience. Reservations are recommended as seating is limited especially during popular performances. Blues Boulevard has established itself as a cultural destination for jazz and blues enthusiasts in the Greenville area.
